ABOUT ON THE BEACH:
This two-bedroom gulf front townhouse is the perfect place for a family to enjoy the beach. On The Beach is located in Inlet Beach and is one of the only spots along 30A that offer the easiest beach access with only 2 steps until your toes are in the sand!

As you walk in the front door, you are greeted by the quaint décor of natural colors throughout and hardwood floors. The first floor offers a large kitchen with plenty of counter space. The large open living room offers a cozy sofa as well as flat screen tv and sliding glass doors that overlook the emerald coast waters. The dining area is just off the living room and offers seating for 6 and additional seating for 2 at the bar. You can also enjoy a beautiful day out on the patio which offers a BBQ grill and table with chairs. The first floor also offers a half bathroom and a washer and dryer.

The second floor offers 2 bedrooms and 2 baths. The master bedroom offers a large area with a King size bed and flat screen tv. The master bedroom has a balcony for you to enjoy the sound of the waves hitting the sand. Sit and enjoy on the 2 chaise loungers. The master bath offers 2 vanities and a shower/tub combo.
The second bedroom is perfect for the kids and grandkids with 2 sets of bunk beds. One offers a full on bottom and twin on top and the other offers twin over twin with a twin trundle. There is a TV to watch DVDs and a full bathroom with shower/tub combo.

This two-bedroom Gulf Front townhome is nestled in the quaint neighborhood of Inlet Beach where you will experience what the beautiful coast has to offer with breathtaking views and beautiful sunsets. On the Beach is located only 1 mile to Rosemary Beach which offers shopping, dining and more for everyone to enjoy. During the summer months, catch a movie or live band out on the greens.

To enhance your stay, On The Beach comes with 2 complimentary Paradise Properties bikes, perfect for exploring the East side of 30A, Inlet Beach, and Rosemary Beach.

ABOUT THE AREA:
Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast.

Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Aly's Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast.

All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

reviews.text: Beautiful home and location! Comfortable beds! Easy check-in and good communication with the hosts. Loved sitting in the outdoor spaces when the wind was too cool to sit on the beach. The second bedroom is perfect for kids and has its own bathroom. Recommendations would be a few more coffee mugs, food storage with lids and a casserole dish or two. Would highly recommend and stay here again.
